components.name: ExpandingButtonGroup
components.doc: A compact pill of icon buttons for actions. One action always shows its label; the one you point at or focus takes over the label while its neighbours slide aside, and an action can confirm in place: the icon draws a check and the label becomes a past tense word. On touch, the first tap reveals the label and a second tap runs the action.

members.name: id
members.doc: Stable key for the action. Also the value passed to onAction.

members.name: label
members.doc: Visible label once the button expands, and its accessible name at all times. Use a short verb, such as "Archive".

members.name: icon
members.doc: Icon shown while collapsed. A 16px lucide icon fits; it is sized by the group.

members.name: onSelect
members.doc: Runs the action. Return false, or reject, to skip the confirmation. A promise keeps the button busy until it settles.

members.name: doneLabel
members.doc: Past tense word shown in place after the action, such as "Archived". The icon becomes a check for confirmDuration. Omit for actions that open something.

members.name: tone
members.doc: "danger" colors the expanded state with the danger token, for destructive actions such as Delete.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Dimmed and inert. Stays focusable and still reveals its label, so people can learn what it would do.

members.name: label
members.doc: Accessible name of the toolbar, such as "Message actions".

members.name: defaultExpanded
members.doc: Id of the action whose label shows at rest, usually the primary one. Defaults to the first enabled action: one action is always expanded. Pointing at or focusing another moves the expansion there, and it returns here when the pointer and focus leave.

members.name: onAction
members.doc: Called with the item id whenever an action runs, before its own onSelect.

members.name: confirmDuration
members.doc: How long the confirmation stays, in milliseconds.
